mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requests WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requests WHERE assignee_id IS NULL
SELECT status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM requests GROUP BY status
SELECT priority AS priority, COUNT(*) AS count FROM requests GROUP BY priority
SELECT u.name AS assigneeName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM requests r JOIN users u ON r.assignee_id = u.user_id WHERE r.assignee_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM requests WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{sinceDays} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at)

SELECT DATE(changed_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM request_status_histories WHERE to_status = 'DONE' AND changed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{sinceDays} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(changed_at) ORDER BY DATE(changed_at)

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, h1.changed_at, h2.changed_at)) FROM request_status_histories h1 JOIN request_status_histories h2 ON h1.request_id = h2.request_id WHERE h1.from_status IS NULL AND h1.to_status = 'WAITING' AND h2.to_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h2.changed_at > h1.changed_at

SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, h1.changed_at, h2.changed_at)) FROM request_status_histories h1 JOIN request_status_histories h2 ON h1.request_id = h2.request_id WHERE h1.to_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h2.to_status = 'DONE' AND h2.changed_at > h1.changed_at
